record.question: Transmission of genes from one bacterium to another neighbour bacterium is known as:
record.explanation: Answer B: Horizontal gene transfer. Transfer of genetic material between bacteria, rather than parent-to-daughter inheritance, is horizontal gene transfer. Conjugation is a particular mechanism when the stem specifies direct neighbor-to-neighbor transfer. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/mesh?Cmd=DetailsSearch&Db=mesh&Term=%22Gene+Transfer%2C+Horizontal%22%5BMeSH+Terms%5D. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
